formulas.name: Quadratic formula
formulas.notes: Gives both roots of a quadratic equation.
formulas.symbols: a, b, c = coefficients of ax² + bx + c = 0

formulas.formula: a / sin A = b / sin B = c / sin C
formulas.name: Law of sines
formulas.notes: Use when you know an angle–side opposite pair.
formulas.symbols: a, b, c = side lengths; A, B, C = opposite angles

formulas.name: Law of cosines
formulas.notes: Use when you know two sides and the included angle.
formulas.symbols: c = side opposite angle C

formulas.name: Sample mean
formulas.symbols: xᵢ = observations; n = sample size

formulas.name: Sample standard deviation
formulas.notes: Divide by n − 1 for a sample, by n for a full population.
formulas.symbols: x̄ = sample mean; n = sample size

formulas.name: Binomial probability
formulas.notes: Each trial independent with the same p.
formulas.symbols: n = trials; k = successes; p = success probability

formulas.name: Compound amount (F given P)
formulas.symbols: F = future worth; P = present worth; i = rate per period; n = periods

formulas.name: Present worth (P given F)
formulas.notes: Discount a future sum back to today.
formulas.symbols: F = future worth; i = rate per period; n = periods

formulas.name: Capital recovery (A given P)
formulas.notes: Converts a present cost into an equivalent annual cost.
formulas.symbols: A = uniform annual amount

formulas.name: Effective interest rate
formulas.notes: Use i_eff whenever compounding is more frequent than the payment period.
formulas.symbols: r = nominal annual rate; m = compounding periods per year

formulas.name: Hierarchy of obligation
formulas.notes: Concept, not a formula: the NSPE canons put public safety, health, and welfare above all other duties. A frequent exam theme.

formulas.name: Equilibrium
formulas.notes: Necessary and sufficient for a body in static equilibrium (planar).

formulas.formula: x̄ = Σ(Aᵢxᵢ) / ΣAᵢ ,  ȳ = Σ(Aᵢyᵢ) / ΣAᵢ
formulas.name: Centroid of a composite area
formulas.notes: Cutouts enter with negative area.
formulas.symbols: Aᵢ = component area; xᵢ, yᵢ = its centroid coordinates

formulas.name: Coulomb friction (impending motion)
formulas.notes: At impending slip, friction acts opposite the impending motion.
formulas.symbols: μ = coefficient of friction (μ_s for static); N = normal force

formulas.name: Velocity with constant acceleration
formulas.symbols: v₀ = initial velocity; a = constant acceleration

formulas.name: Displacement with constant acceleration
formulas.symbols: s₀ = initial position

formulas.name: Velocity–displacement relation
formulas.notes: Use when time t is unknown or not asked.

formulas.name: Newton's second law
formulas.notes: Apply per coordinate direction.
formulas.symbols: ΣF = vector sum of forces; m = mass

formulas.name: Work–energy principle
formulas.notes: Often faster than kinematics when forces vary with position.
formulas.symbols: T = ½mv² kinetic energy; U = work of forces

formulas.name: Axial stress
formulas.notes: Tensile positive by convention.
formulas.symbols: P = axial load; A = cross-sectional area

formulas.name: Axial deformation
formulas.notes: Elongation positive for tensile P.
formulas.symbols: L = length; E = elastic modulus

formulas.name: Flexure formula
formulas.notes: Maximum stress at the extreme fiber, y = c.
formulas.symbols: M = bending moment; y = distance from neutral axis; I = moment of inertia

formulas.name: Transverse shear stress
formulas.notes: Maximum usually at the neutral axis.
formulas.symbols: V = shear force; Q = first moment of area; t = width at the level

formulas.formula: τ = Tr / J ,   φ = TL / JG
formulas.name: Torsion: stress and angle of twist
formulas.notes: Maximum shear at the outer surface.
formulas.symbols: T = torque; r = radius; J = polar moment; G = shear modulus; L = length

formulas.name: Hooke's law (uniaxial)
formulas.notes: Valid in the linear-elastic range.
formulas.symbols: E = modulus of elasticity; ε = normal strain

formulas.name: Abrams' law (concrete strength)
formulas.notes: Strength falls as water–cement ratio rises — the single most-tested concrete concept.
formulas.symbols: f′c = compressive strength; w/c = water–cement ratio; k₁, k₂ = empirical constants

formulas.name: Continuity
formulas.notes: Incompressible, steady flow.
formulas.symbols: Q = discharge; A = area; V = mean velocity

formulas.formula: p₁/γ + V₁²/2g + z₁ = p₂/γ + V₂²/2g + z₂ + h_L
formulas.name: Bernoulli (with head loss)
formulas.notes: Along a streamline for steady, incompressible flow.
formulas.symbols: p/γ = pressure head; V²/2g = velocity head; z = elevation head; h_L = head loss

formulas.name: Reynolds number
formulas.notes: Re < ~2,100 laminar; Re > ~4,000 turbulent in pipes.
formulas.symbols: ρ = density; μ = dynamic viscosity; ν = kinematic viscosity; D = diameter

formulas.name: Darcy–Weisbach head loss
formulas.notes: Major (friction) loss in full pipe flow.
formulas.symbols: f = friction factor (Moody chart); L = pipe length

formulas.name: Hydrostatic force on a plane surface
formulas.notes: Center of pressure is always below the centroid.
formulas.symbols: h_c = depth of centroid; y measured along the plane from the free surface

formulas.name: Stadia distance
formulas.notes: For a horizontal sight; incline corrections apply otherwise.
formulas.symbols: K = stadia interval factor (usually 100); s = rod intercept; C = instrument constant

formulas.name: Combined curvature and refraction
formulas.notes: Curvature (+0.667M²) minus refraction (−0.093M²). Subtract from the observed elevation difference.
formulas.symbols: M = sight distance in miles; C = correction in feet

formulas.name: Simply supported beam, uniform load
formulas.notes: Max moment and deflection both at midspan.
formulas.symbols: w = load per length; L = span

formulas.name: Cantilever, point load at free end
formulas.notes: Max moment at the fixed support.
formulas.symbols: P = tip load; L = length

formulas.name: Euler buckling load
formulas.notes: K = 1.0 pinned–pinned, 0.5 fixed–fixed, 2.0 fixed–free.
formulas.symbols: K = effective length factor; L = unbraced length

formulas.name: Effective stress
formulas.notes: Soil strength and settlement depend on effective stress, not total.
formulas.symbols: σ = total stress; u = pore water pressure

formulas.name: Dry unit weight
formulas.symbols: γ = moist unit weight; w = water content (decimal)

formulas.name: Void ratio and porosity
formulas.notes: n = V_v/V_total.
formulas.symbols: V_v = voids volume; V_s = solids volume

formulas.name: Terzaghi ultimate bearing capacity
formulas.notes: Strip footing; apply shape/depth factors per the handbook for other cases.
formulas.symbols: c = cohesion; D_f = footing depth; B = footing width; N = bearing factors

formulas.name: Stopping sight distance (US units)
formulas.notes: First term = reaction distance; second = braking distance.
formulas.symbols: V = speed (mph); t = perception–reaction (s); f = friction; G = grade (decimal, + uphill)

formulas.name: Superelevation
formulas.notes: Use maximum e allowed by agency before solving for R.
formulas.symbols: e = superelevation rate; f_s = side friction; V = mph; R = radius (ft)

formulas.name: Rational method (peak runoff)
formulas.notes: Watch units: with i in in/hr and A in acres, Q is in cfs.
formulas.symbols: C = runoff coefficient; i = rainfall intensity; A = drainage area

formulas.name: Manning's equation (US units)
formulas.notes: For SI, replace 1.486 with 1.0.
formulas.symbols: n = roughness; R = hydraulic radius; S = energy slope

formulas.name: CPM float
formulas.notes: Zero-float activities define the critical path. Forward pass gives ES/EF; backward pass gives LS/LF.
formulas.symbols: ES/EF = early start/finish; LS/LF = late start/finish
